rent.note: furnished 1BR (AC) in Galle/Unawatuna, ~149,000 LKR at 330.4 LKR/USD. Local-market furnished 1BR on ikman ~Rs 90,000 ($272); foreigner-targeted Fort/beach units $400-700; nomads.com 1BR $531. Thin listing base, so the figure is mostly editorial

utilities.note: electric (AC) + water + fibre; guide range $50-90; often bundled into foreigner rentals

groceries.note: single person cooking at home $100-160; imported goods cost more

diningOut.note: rice-and-curry/local meals $1.50-3, café/restaurant mains $4-10 in the Fort and Unawatuna

transit.note: tuk-tuks (~$1 a short trip), buses and the coast train; guide range $20-60; scooter rental would add more

coworking.note: café-scale spaces; crowd figure $120/mo; Abode Ahangama day pass ~3,500 LKR (~$10.60); no operator monthly price page found

accomSeasonality._doc: Rent-only multipliers Jan..Dec. South-west coast season Dec-Mar (SLTDA leisure arrivals peak Dec-Mar, trough May-Jun with the SW monsoon); Oct-Nov inter-monsoon rains keep the south coast soft until December.
